items.difficulty_reason: The lemma factors any morphism of the differential graded category through an admissible monomorphism that admits a retraction split up to homotopy (statement lines 3937-3953). The proof (lines 3955-4016) is a hands-on construction: the direct-sum object from axiom (A) with its splitting identities, the assembly of tilde-alpha from the cone sequence of the identity and the verification that it sits in an admissible short exact sequence, and the explicit three-line homotopy computation 1 - s pi = t p = t (d h) p = d(t h p) using the null-cone lemma. H2: short, but the splitting bookkeeping and the homotopy computation are the argument and the result underpins the cone-factorization technology of the chapter.
